Product Overview

JAKEHOE Multi-Purpose Cleaning Tablets are pre-portioned solid tablets that dissolve in water for routine household cleaning. Each retail box contains 30 individually wrapped tablets.

Suggested Uses

Use the prepared solution on label-approved washable hard surfaces or kitchen utensils. For compatible washable textiles, follow the care label and rinse thoroughly after soaking.

How to Use

Dissolve a tablet in a basin of water. For hard surfaces, apply the prepared solution with a towel and rinse or wipe as appropriate. For compatible washable textiles, soak for 10 to 15 minutes and rinse with plenty of water.

Package Information

Includes 30 solid cleaning tablets. Package dimensions: 10.3 x 4.0 x 9.5 cm. Gross weight: 85 g. Shelf life: 3 years. Made in China.

Ingredients Shown on Source Artwork

Sodium bicarbonate, citric acid, sodium lauryl sulfate, sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate, disodium EDTA, peppermint leaf extract and lemon fruit extract.

Care Notes

Follow the product label and the surface or textile manufacturer's care guidance. Test a small inconspicuous area first. Keep out of reach of children, avoid eye contact and do not mix with other cleaning products.

Universeller Bremsentlüftungs-Adapter mit 90°-Winkel, verstellbar 28–70 mm, Spezialanschluss für Bremsflüssigkeitsbehälter

 

Produkt-Highlights

 
90°-Winkel-Design: Optimiert für enge Räume, besonders flexibel und praktisch im Motorraum
 
Spezielle Dichtkonstruktion: Passt zu Bremsflüssigkeitsbehältern mit umgebogenem Rand, sorgt für dichten Anschluss während der Entlüftung
 
Schlauchanschluss mit Winkel: Einfacher Anschluss des Entlüftungsschlauchs, auch bei beengten Einbauverhältnissen
 
Hochwertiges Material: Aus langlebigem, bremsflüssigkeitsbeständigem Kunststoff gefertigt, hohe Lebensdauer
 
Einfache Bedienung: Werkzeuglose manuelle Verstellung, schneller Einbau am Behälter
 

Technische Daten

 
Produkttyp: Bremsentlüftungs-Adapter
 
Anschlussart: US-Standard-Anschluss
 
Winkel: 90°
 
Befestigung: Schnellverschluss mit umgebogenem Rand
 
Anschluss: Schnellanschluss mit Winkelschlauch
 
Abmessungen: ca. 18 cm × 11 cm × 9 cm (L×B×H)
 
Material: Ölbeständiger Kunststoff
 
Verpackung: Einzelverpackung
 
Zustand: Neu, unbenutzt
 

Lieferumfang

 
1 × Verstellbarer Bremsentlüftungs-Adapter (90°-Winkel-Design)
 

Anwendungsbereiche

 
  1. Bremsflüssigkeitswechsel: Anschluss an Entlüftungsgeräte, dichte Abdichtung des Behälters, Lufteintritt verhindern
  2. Bremsanlage entlüften: Nach Reparatur von Bremszylindern, Hauptbremszylinder oder Bremschläuchen
  3. Enge Motorräume: Ideal für Fahrzeuge mit begrenztem Platz im Motorraum
  4. Wartung von Mehrkolbenbremsen: Professionelles Hilfswerkzeug für Hochleistungsbremsen
  5. ABS-Reparatur: Entlüften und Druckprüfung nach ABS-Pumpenwechsel
  6. Oldtimer-Restaurierung: Passt zu nicht genormten Bremsflüssigkeitsbehältern
  7. Werkstattausstattung: Standardwerkzeug für Werkstätten und Autohäuser
  8. DIY-Pflege: Für Bremswartung am Privatfahrzeug, nutzbar mit Hand- oder Druckentlüfter
 

Bedienungsanleitung

 
  • Adapter auf die Einfüllöffnung des Bremsflüssigkeitsbehälters setzen und auf passenden Durchmesser (28–70 mm) einstellen
  • Sicherstellen, dass der Verschluss sicher am umgebogenen Rand einrastet und abdichtet
  • Entlüftungsschlauch an den Winkelanschluss des Adapters anschließen
  • Entlüften oder Befüllen der Bremsflüssigkeit durchführen
  • Nach Abschluss zuerst den Druck abbauen, dann den Adapter entfernen
 

Sicherheitshinweise

 
️ Vor dem Einsatz prüfen, ob der Durchmesser der Behälteröffnung 28–70 mm beträgt
 
️ Sicherstellen, dass der Behälter einen umgebogenen Rand hat, sonst ist kein fester Halt möglich
 
️ Zu starkes Neigen des Adapters während des Betriebs vermeiden, um Undichtigkeiten zu verhindern
 
️ Nach Gebrauch Bremsflüssigkeitsrückstände reinigen und trocken lagern
 
️ Nur für übliche Bremsflüssigkeiten DOT3/DOT4/DOT5.1 geeignet

products.title: GlowScent Smart Hair, Scalp Care Comb
products.body_html:
GlowScent – Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb

GlowScent is an innovative daily hair and scalp care device that combines hair care, hydration, protection, fine mist application, vibration massage, and red LED light therapy in one easy-to-use experience.

Designed to become part of your daily hair-care routine, GlowScent allows you to choose the liquid that best suits your hair-care needs and distribute it as a fine mist while brushing.

 Three Care Formulas

GlowScent comes with 3 refillable capsules and 3 specially formulated liquids, each designed for a different part of your hair-care routine:

 Smooth Shield

Designed to be part of your daily hair-care and protection routine, helping leave hair feeling smoother and easier to manage.

 Hydration Touch

Designed to provide your hair with a hydrated, refreshed feel, making it suitable for everyday hair-care routines.

 Pure Scent

Designed to give your hair a fresh, pleasant fragrance while remaining part of your overall hair-care experience—not simply a traditional perfume.

Choose the capsule and formula that best fits your hair and your daily routine.

Refillable Capsules

GlowScent capsules are designed to be refilled and reused with the specially formulated GlowScent liquids.

How to Refill the Capsule

  1. Remove the capsule from the device.
  2. The capsule will be empty and sealed with a rubber stopper.
  3. Carefully remove the stopper.
  4. Take the GlowScent liquid you want to use.
  5. Fill the capsule with the amount of liquid you need.
  6. Securely replace the stopper.
  7. Insert the capsule back into the GlowScent device.
  8. The device is now ready to use.

Important: Do not use other liquids, perfumes, or formulas in the capsules. Only use the specially formulated GlowScent liquids to ensure proper compatibility with the device and mist system.

How to Operate GlowScent

GlowScent is designed for simple one-touch control.

First Press

Turns the device on and activates Red LED Light Mode.

Second Press

Switches to Light Mist Mode.

Third Press

Switches to Stronger Mist Mode.

Long Press

Turns the device off.

You can easily switch between modes during your hair-care routine.

Red LED Light

GlowScent features an integrated red LED light system designed to be part of your daily hair and scalp care routine.

Use the red LED mode while gently moving the device through your hair and across the scalp.

Vibration Scalp Massage

GlowScent features a built-in vibration massage function designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing scalp-care experience while brushing.

Massage Controls

One touch on the top of the device:
Turns the massage on.

One more touch:
Turns the massage off.

Long touch:
Adjusts the vibration intensity higher or lower according to your preference.

Choose the vibration level that feels most comfortable while gently moving the device across your scalp.

Hair Care + Fine Mist in One Step

Instead of manually applying your hair-care formula, GlowScent allows you to distribute the selected liquid as a fine mist while brushing your hair.

Use:

Smooth Shield for protection and care
Hydration Touch for hydration and refreshment
Pure Scent for hair care with a fresh fragrance

This allows you to combine hair care, hydration, protection, and freshness into one simple daily routine.

1000mAh Rechargeable Battery

GlowScent is equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable lithium battery.

With moderate use, one full charge can last for up to one month when the device is used for approximately 5 minutes per day.

The device uses USB Type-C charging.

What’s Included

  • 1 × GlowScent Smart Hair & Scalp Care Comb
  • 1 × Charging Base
  • 3 × Refillable Capsules
  • 1 × Smooth Shield Formula
  • 1 × Hydration Touch Formula
  • 1 × Pure Scent Formula
  • 1 × USB Type-C Charging Cable

Your Daily GlowScent Routine

Choose your formula → Fill the capsule → Insert the capsule → Turn on the device → Select your mist level → Brush through your hair and scalp → Activate the massage when needed → Enjoy your complete hair-care routine.

GlowScent

Care. Protect. Hydrate. Refresh.

Relaxed Silhouette
A loose A-line shape combined with a waist-draped pleat design flatters all body types, effectively concealing curves and creating a slimming effect. Its flowing drape adds an effortlessly elegant touch, making it perfect for various casual settings such as vacations, beaches, and markets.

Contrasting Detail Design
A deep V-neckline paired with vibrant orange trims along the sides and hem brightens the overall look against a neutral gray base. This retro-chic combination creates eye-catching style while subtly elongating the neck line.

Breathable, Skin-Friendly Fabric
Made from lightweight, slightly crinkled sheer fabric that offers excellent breathability and prevents sweat buildup. With a soft drape and subtle texture, it feels cool and comfortable in summer, evoking a laid-back vacation vibe.

Functional Details
Hidden side pockets provide convenient storage for phones, lipsticks, and small essentials. Adjustable shoulder straps allow for a customized fit, accommodating different shoulder shapes for greater comfort.

Versatile Styling Options
Wear it solo as a standout summer dress or layer over cardigans or denim jackets. Paired with straw hats and woven bags, it easily transitions between bohemian, casual, and vintage styles.

The Nocturne Lace Gown is a masterpiece of dark romanticism and modern allure.
